focus_areas: Legibility of text on paper tags
Texture realism of pastry surfaces (crumb vs. waxiness)
Logical consistency of glass reflections and object boundaries
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the micro-textures of the baked goods: do they show realistic crumb structures and crust variations, or do they appear airbrushed/plastic? Analyze the reflections on the glass: do they match the geometry of the items inside? Crucially, examine the small paper tags: is the text legible and consistent with real handwriting/print, or is it hallucinated gibberish?
image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a bakery display case filled with an assortment of golden-brown pastries and buns. The items are arranged on trays behind a glass front, which shows reflections and glare. Visible items include round buns, twisted pastries, and some with colorful toppings or fillings. Small paper tags (pink and white) are inserted into some of the baked goods. The lighting is warm and artificial, typical of a retail display.
